risk_summary: The disclosure presents severe financial and operating risk, including secured-loan defaults, historic losses, working-capital deficits, margin deterioration, and substantial doubt about going-concern status. COVID-19-related demand and commodity-price volatility materially reduced cash flow, while affiliate dependence and concentration add counterparty and governance risk. Although the excerpt provides several quantified figures, repeated contingencies and broad uncertainty language limit visibility into recovery timing and financing capacity.
